# murmur

> Every voice matters · Każdy głos ma znaczenie. A free, browser-only classroom board for lectures, seminars and webinars that lets instructors hear students who don't speak up. Participants join via QR code, link or a 10-character code (e.g. K7M2P-9XQ4R) — no account, anonymous by default — and drop questions, doubts, ideas and quick reactions as cards.

Author: MagTk (https://github.com/magtk). License: PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 — free for education, individuals and non-profits; commercial use requires a separate licence. Interface: Polish and English.

## What it does

- Sections of cards; participants add, edit and delete their own cards
- Voting, drag-and-drop grouping (also via keyboard), sorting by votes
- "Think first" mode: cards stay hidden until the instructor reveals them (manually or with a timer)
- Short single- and multiple-choice quizzes with timer and live results
- Discreet counter of how many people have contributed
- Export to Markdown, PNG, PDF and JSON; board templates stored as JSON
- WCAG 2.2 AA (audited with axe-core), light/dark theme, works on phones

## How it works

- No backend and no database: the instructor's browser holds the board; participants connect peer-to-peer via WebRTC (Trystero library, signalling through public Nostr relays, encrypted)
- The instructor is verified by an ECDSA key fingerprint embedded in the link/code
- Boards are temporary: they expire 7–30 days after the last change (default 21) and are removed from the browser
- Suitable for ~30–40 participants per board
